moves.comment: White takes the centre. You answer with ...c6, a solid move that prepares ...d5.

children.comment: This is the Caro-Kann. You get ...d5 next, with a safe king and no weak pawns.
White builds a big centre.
Hit the centre at once. Now White must decide what to do with the e4 pawn.
The Advance Variation. White gains space.

Now the bishop is outside your pawn chain. Close the centre and stay solid.

Take the pawn. If they take back, you play on with an easy game.
